exact_question: For P0/P1/P2/P3/P4, which placement classes are physically/software feasible on the current platform, what exact data path would each require, and what optimistic lower bound on creation+handoff cost determines whether a runtime experiment is worth opening?

current_platform.caveat: 136 GB/s is a vendor/IP roof already frozen in the hardware model, not measured sustained workload bandwidth.

key_architecture_result.statement: On the current Lunar Lake host, CPU/GPU/NPU creator choice does not imply a separate active residency capacity domain; the validated execution image remains a GPU-accessible system-UMA allocation. Creator, residency, handoff, and lifetime must be reasoned independently.
consequence: Moving creation to GPU or NPU does not remove the ~549.5 MB active EXEC148 residency cost.
P3 sidecar can move creation out of inference runtime but still needs a GPU-accessible active image when B executes.
Under memory pressure the clean policy is evict B and fall back to A, not assume an NPU/GPU private-memory refuge exists.

common_bounds.decision_formula: For one-time placement overhead C with no additional steady-state penalty, B beats A after H > C/(L_A-L_B).

P0_CPU_DIRECT_UMA.exact_path: resident source Q4_K -> CPU exact-byte materializer -> mapped final Vulkan HOST_VISIBLE|HOST_COHERENT|DEVICE_LOCAL UMA buffer -> B kernel
P0_CPU_DIRECT_UMA.note: CPU optimization itself is implementation-maturity work, not a new placement class.

P1_GPU_CREATE_IN_PLACE.exact_path: resident source Q4_K Vulkan buffers -> Vulkan compute materializer over independent blocks -> final EXEC148 storage buffer in same UMA memory domain -> barrier -> B kernel
P1_GPU_CREATE_IN_PLACE.key_risk: GPU creation can contend with the same GPU needed by prefill/decode if performed lazily on the critical path.
P1_GPU_CREATE_IN_PLACE.prerequisite: Freeze exact GPU materializer, correctness tuple, and serialized-versus-overlapped lifecycle contract before timing.

P2_NPU_CREATE_OR_MAINTAIN.interop_fact: Current OpenVINO NPU Remote Tensor APIs document Windows NT-handle/shared-memory interop with native APIs including Vulkan, but ArcLLM's existing Vulkan allocations were not proven exportable/importable under that path.
P2_NPU_CREATE_OR_MAINTAIN.exact_best_case_path: shared/exportable source Q4_K -> NPU exact transform -> shared/exportable EXEC148 allocation -> Vulkan import/use
P2_NPU_CREATE_OR_MAINTAIN.transform_support_gap: OpenVINO defines required bitwise operations at framework level, but device support is plugin-specific; exact Lunar Lake NPU compilation of the EXEC148 byte/bit graph has not been proven.
P2_NPU_CREATE_OR_MAINTAIN.next_allowed: Compile-only/static capability probe for exact transform ops + memory-handle compatibility. No performance benchmark until both pass.
P2_NPU_CREATE_OR_MAINTAIN.dependency_rule: Only promote if P1/P3 results leave a concrete architecture reason to offload creation away from GPU/CPU.

P3_OFFLINE_PREMATERIALIZED_SIDECAR.exact_path: offline/install-time exact EXEC148 creator -> versioned 549,527,552-byte sidecar -> runtime identity/hash check -> load/copy into final GPU-accessible UMA Vulkan buffer -> B kernel
P3_OFFLINE_PREMATERIALIZED_SIDECAR.cold_load_bound: Storage bandwidth is not measured in the frozen host evidence; cold-load cost remains parameterized by effective sidecar-to-final-buffer throughput.
P3_OFFLINE_PREMATERIALIZED_SIDECAR.prerequisite: Freeze sidecar identity/versioning, direct-to-final-buffer load path, cold/warm cache states, and exact storage-vs-memory accounting.

P4_OTHER_ENGINE_AUDIO_DSP_ETC.observed_vendor_scope: Audio DSP is exposed under the HD Audio subsystem for audio/voice offload; vendor documentation mentions host-downloadable firmware and remote DDR windows, but this does not establish a supported ArcLLM application compute interface.
P4_OTHER_ENGINE_AUDIO_DSP_ETC.reopen_rule: Only reopen P4 upon concrete public runtime/API evidence showing programmable exact-byte transform plus source/destination memory access and a plausible bound that could change the A-vs-B decision.

architecture_policy_implications: A is the default/fallback whenever EXEC148 is absent, invalid, not amortized, or evicted.
B active residency remains ~549.5 MB on the current UMA platform regardless of CPU/GPU/NPU creator.
P3 is a lifecycle optimization: it moves creation out of inference runtime but does not eliminate active residency.
P1 is a creator-latency optimization: it may reduce creation cost but can compete with inference for GPU time.
P2 has value only if exact-transform support and shared-memory interoperability are proven and if avoiding CPU/GPU creator contention would materially change policy.

next.purpose: Design two independent bounded experiments for P1 and P3 without changing EXEC148 semantics or A baseline; preregister cold/warm/lifetime accounting and correctness before any timing.
next.P2_parallel_optional: A zero-science compile/memory-interop capability probe may be designed separately, but it does not block P1/P3.
forbidden: NPU performance benchmark before capability pass

external_sources.claim_scope: Arc 140V and Intel AI Boost NPU presence; NPU 47 TOPS; supported AI frameworks.
NPU Remote Tensor memory sharing/native-handle mechanisms including Windows NT handles and Vulkan/native API interoperability.
Bitwise operations exist in OpenVINO operation sets; device support remains plugin/platform dependent.
Lunar Lake audio DSP purpose/capabilities under HD Audio subsystem; HIFI4 DSP cores, SRAM, remote DDR access, host-downloadable firmware.
